content: To use the medication effectively, apply it to your gum, the inside of your lip, or your cheek. If the tablet does not adhere or falls off within the first six hours, reapply it as directed. If it still does not stick, replace it with a new tablet. However, if the tablet falls off or is accidentally swallowed after six hours or more, do not apply a new dose. Antifungal medications work best when the drug level in your body remains consistent. Continue using the medication for the full prescribed duration, even if symptoms improve after a few days. Common side effects may include discomfort, sores, taste changes, or irritation and pain in the mouth. Other possible side effects include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, or headache. This medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. If you experience any side effects, contact your doctor for medical advice. Before using miconazole buccal tablets, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to miconazole or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients, such as milk protein concentrate, which could cause allergic reactions or other issues. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if clearly needed, and it is unknown if it passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. This medication is prescribed for your current condition only and should not be shared with others. If you miss a dose, use it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store the medication at room temperature, away from moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard the product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
